aiOverview.content: The 2025 Samsung S90F (42"–83") is a top-tier mid-range 4K QD-OLED smart TV featuring the NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor, brilliant 144Hz motion for gaming, and excellent bright-room performance. Highlights include vibrant colors, deep blacks, and a 24% discount (65-inch model) to $1,298.Key Features and PerformancePicture Quality: Utilizes QD-OLED technology for high contrast, "pitch-black" levels, and impressive HDR peak brightness.Processor: NQ4 AI Gen3 Processor handles 4K AI Upscaling Pro, optimizing picture/sound via Samsung Vision AI.Gaming: Supports 144Hz refresh rate with Motion Xcelerator and has near-instantaneous response times and low input lag.Design & OS: Extremely thin panel. Runs on Tizen OS, providing fast access to streaming apps.Sizes: Available in 42, 48, 55, 65, 77, and 83 inches.This video provides a first-hand look at the Samsung S90F's design and features:59sThe MegawattsYouTube• Dec 8, 2025Pros & ConsPros: Incredible, vibrant picture quality; excellent for gaming; effective anti-glare for a moderately bright room.Cons: No Dolby Vision support; black levels may appear slightly raised in very bright rooms.PricingThe 65-inch model is currently priced at $1,298, down from $1,698, making it one of the best value premium OLED options available right now,.Note: Pricing and stock availability are based on reports from April 17, 2026.
